remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully maintained Cape-style rental! With its fresh paint, refinished floors, and thoughtful features, this property is ready to embrace you. Here's what makes it stand out: The kitchen boasts an inviting island and breakfast bar, along with modern appliances including a gas oven range, microwave, dishwasher, and refrigerator. Adjacent to the kitchen, a convenient mudroom houses a washer and dryer, providing easy access to the large rear lot. The dining room, adorned with hardwood floors, enjoys double exposure for abundant natural light. A pretty arched doorway leads to the spacious living room, which extends seamlessly to an enclosed porch-a perfect spot for relaxation and leisure. Two main-level bedrooms feature hardwood floors and one full bathroom. Upstairs, discover an open walk-in loft area with a window-ideal for a home office or creative space. Two additional bedrooms with ample closets share a well-appointed hallway bathroom with a large shower. Outside, the level backyard invites grilling, entertaining, and outdoor enjoyment. Owner reserves the right to the basement - which has its own separate entrance. This home is conveniently located near major shopping centers, the SONO Collection, and a variety of restaurants with easy access to I-95 and Route 7.
